relationships.subject: miR-133b-3p
relationships.evidence_quote: genetic overexpression of miR-133b-3p in the VPL reversed the allodynia established in CPSP rats via downregulation of P2X4R expression

relationships.subject: P2X4R
relationships.evidence_quote: Genetic knockdown of P2X4R in the VPL protected CPSP rats against allodynia

relationships.evidence_quote: genetic overexpression of miR-133b-3p in the VPL reversed the allodynia established in CPSP rats via downregulation of P2X4R expression

relationships.subject: gabapentin
relationships.evidence_quote: Treatment using gabapentin in CPSP rats significantly restored the decreased miR-133b-3p expression in the VPL, CSF, and plasma and blocked allodynia in CPSP rats

key_findings: miR-133b-3p is reduced in VPL, CSF and plasma of CPSP rats and in CPSP patient plasma; overexpression in VPL reverses allodynia via P2X4R downregulation.
Gabapentin restores miR-133b-3p, and an miR-133b-3p inhibitor in VPL abolishes gabapentin's antiallodynic effect.
